title: Digitized figure point series
description: Return contract for the external figure-digitization pipeline. One file per catalog record; see mhtdb/figure_points.py for the input side.

record_id.description: Catalog record this data belongs to.

extractor.description: Name and version of the digitizer that produced this, e.g. 'figdig-0.3'.

quantity.description: Field name, preferably from taxonomy/v1/facets.yaml numeric_fields (q_flux, dT_wall, htc, x_quality, G, ...). Free text allowed for quantities the taxonomy does not name yet.

unit.description: Unit as printed on the axis. Not converted — mhtdb.normalize handles SI.

figure_id.description: Matches FigureInput.figure_id supplied by s0_ingest, e.g. 'fig-5'.

label.description: Legend text for this curve as printed.

conditions.description: Per-series conditions that distinguish it from siblings in the same figure — the surface, fluid, pressure, or mass flux that curve corresponds to. Keys should match numeric_fields or facet terms where possible.

points.description: Ordered [x, y] pairs. A third element may carry a per-point uncertainty on y.

uncertainty.description: Digitization uncertainty, distinct from the paper's own experimental uncertainty.
